query: Which early-warning metrics (narrative–resource misalignment, KPI omission, sudden budget shifts, external sanctions) best detect greenwashing or mission drift?

response.query: Which early-warning metrics (narrative–resource misalignment, KPI omission, sudden budget shifts, external sanctions) best detect greenwashing or mission drift?
response.answer: Sudden budget shifts and KPI omission best detect greenwashing or mission drift. External sanctions can also indicate misalignment. Narrative–resource misalignment is less direct.
